gaps.sentence: ___ of my parents speaks French, so I translate for them.
gaps.explanation: 'Neither of' = not one and not the other (two people).

gaps.sentence: It's the first time I've ___ eaten oysters.
gaps.explanation: 'The first time + present perfect + ever' emphasises novelty.

gaps.sentence: The scheme, ___ was announced yesterday, will cost the city millions.
gaps.explanation: Non-defining clauses about things take 'which'; 'that' is impossible after a comma.

gaps.sentence: The findings will be published in ___ course.
gaps.hint: in ___ course = at the right time
gaps.explanation: 'In due course' = eventually, when the time is right.

gaps.sentence: I'd rather walk than ___ the bus.
gaps.explanation: 'would rather do A than do B' — both bare infinitives.

gaps.sentence: We'd better ___ going — it's nearly midnight.
Unless it ___ , the match will go ahead.
gaps.explanation: 'unless' = if…not; present simple after time/condition words.
